prompt.text:
Implement a normalized collection of sampled integer spans in `solution.rs`, using only the standard library. Expose public `Sample`, `Segment`, and `SegmentSet` types with the reference API. `Segment::new(start,end,samples)` rejects `start > end`, samples outside the inclusive boundary, and duplicate sample positions. It sorts samples by position. `SegmentSet::add` inserts a segment and merges every overlapping or touching segment (touching means `left.end + 1 == right.start`, without overflow). The merged boundary is the union. If multiple samples share a position, the value from the newly added segment wins; when existing segments are merged among themselves, later segments in normalized boundary order win. `normalize` sorts and performs the same transitive merging. `subset(start,end)` returns an empty set when `start > end`; otherwise it intersects boundaries and retains only samples inside each intersection. `segments`, `is_empty`, and `subset` must not mutate the source. Output segments and samples are always ascending.
